definition: the things needed to do a job or service
description: Four short shots of people cleaning, each built around the kit they use. A woman in yellow rubber gloves pushes a blue sponge in circles through soapy water on a white kitchen worktop. A man in a grey uniform swings a round spin mop on a yellow pole across a glossy office floor while staff work at desks behind him. A window cleaner in a blue hard hat, orange safety harness and white gloves draws a squeegee down a skyscraper pane from a hanging cradle, the city far below. A man in a grey T-shirt bends over a wooden floor in an empty flat with a cloth, buckets and bottles lined up behind him.
